description: Defines the EmailAddressRelationship class, a table-based many-to-many relationship handler extending M2MRelationship, with methods for adding and removing email address relationships in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: EmailAddressRelationship
classes.description: Represents a many-to-many relationship for email addresses, extending M2MRelationship, with custom add and remove logic.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between the left and right SugarBean objects, handling relationship loading and table insertion.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the relationship between the specified SugarBean objects, with checks and relationship table deletion.

methods.name: getRoleWhere
methods.description: Generates SQL WHERE clause for role filtering, with special handling for primary_address role.
